text:
alice: heads-up, starting rolling deploy for inference-runtime v1.3.7 -> v1.4.0 in the change window (now). keeping feature toggle `ff.infer_v1_4` OFF for initial canary so only 2% gets the new path.
ben: copy. plan: 2% canary -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% if latency & errors look good. backoff on p95 +300ms or error >1%.
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated: release=v1.4.0 target=eng-prod canary=2% initiator=alice
carol: can we pin traffic for latency-sensitive orgs? suggest pin `org_pin:stable_v1_3` for customers spend>1000/mo.
alice: yes, will run pin-tool to apply pins. command I'll run: `pin-tool apply --criteria spend>1000 --version v1.3.7`
ben: add backpressure guard: if p95 increases >300ms OR error_rate >1% for 5m -> pause ramp and set `ff.infer_v1_4=false` for new sessions. also autoscale GPU pool if pending queue >100.
sre-oncall: dashboards and alerts set (eng-release/high-latency). runbook: if errors >2% for 10m -> rollback to v1.3.7 and open incident.
deploy-bot: Ramp schedule: 2% -> 10% (in 12m) -> 30% (in 45m) -> 100% (in 3h). backoff_policy=exponential max-pauses=3 auto-fallback=compatible-quantized
carol: also keep KV-cache warmers enabled for the canary path. if cache-miss rate >20% pause ramp.
alice: tagging release notes: "serve: optimized attention kernel; memory/perf tradeoff; quantized fallback available". flipping 2% canary flag in 2m.
pm-jordan: confirmed customer pin list in GH: https://git.internal/release/pins (shared)
alice: rolling canary now, flipping flag for 2% subset.
deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: ff.infer_v1_4=true scope=2% by=alice
carol: warmup traces look OK. p95 +40ms initially.
ben: p95 trending +120ms after 8m; error_rate=0.6% — continue to watch closely.
sre-oncall: scaling GPUs preemptively, watching memory allocations.
alice: prepping 10% step; will wait full 12m unless alerts fire.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 10% completed
ben: p95 jumped +380ms in shard-us-west-3, error rate creeping to 1.3% in that shard — triggering backpressure now. I'm going to toggle flag OFF for new sessions while we investigate.
alice: running `ffctl set ff.infer_v1_4 false --scope new-sessions` now
deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: ff.infer_v1_4=false by=alice
carol: traffic shifted back to stable. errors dropping. we'll pin affected large customers to v1.3.7 while we root-cause.
ben: quick note: memory spike aligns with quantization kernel on Batch-3 path. opening issue ENG-5821 to track.
alice: creating incident ticket, adding rollback notes to release doc and support playbook.
pm-jordan: drafting customer comms for pinned accounts. will send to legal & success for review.
ben: remediation plan: 1) revert the kernel change in canary branch and re-run mem tests; 2) re-run canary with `small-batch` mode + KV warmers forced; 3) add a tighter memory guard and make backpressure threshold more conservative for next ramp.
carol: agree. I'll also add a temporary rule to pin any org with sustained latency >250ms to stable for 24h.
sre-oncall: monitoring will keep alerting. re-open if we see secondary spikes.
alice: thanks everyone. moving this to follow-up action items and postmortem. :thumbsup:
